findings.quoted_text: one Party's performance of its obligations hereunder (including but not limited to such Party's ability to perform this Agreement) is,  in the reasonable judgment of the other Party, adversely affected by the occurrence of any event, then the unaffected Party  may terminate this Agreement upon notifying the other Party in writing;

one Party's performance of its obligations hereunder (including but not limited to such Party's ability to perform this Agreement) is, in the reasonable judgment of the other Party, adversely affected by the occurrence of any event, then the unaffected Party may terminate this Agreement upon notifying the other Party in writing;
findings.explanation: This clause allows either party to terminate based on a subjective judgment that the other party's performance is adversely affected, creating uncertainty and potential for one-sided exit.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice if the other party experiences a material adverse effect on its ability to perform its obligations that remains uncured for thirty days.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause stating that one Party's performance of its obligations hereunder (including but not limited to such Party's ability to perform this Agreement) is, in the reasonable judgment of the other Party, adversely affected by the occurrence of any event, then the unaffected Party may terminate this Agreement upon notifying the other Party in writing;, this currently creates uncertainty due to subjective judgment; please update this to either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice if the other party experiences a material adverse effect on its ability to perform its obligations that remains uncured for thirty days. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you. Best regards,
